setup.title: Let’s set up {company}
setup.lead: A few questions, so noddo arrives set up, not blank. You can change any of it later.

size.label: How many people are in the company?

country.label: Where is the company based?
country.hintFor: Sets your time zone to {timezone}, starts the week on {weekday, select, MONDAY {Monday} TUESDAY {Tuesday} WEDNESDAY {Wednesday} THURSDAY {Thursday} FRIDAY {Friday} SATURDAY {Saturday} SUNDAY {Sunday} other {the first working day}} and builds {country}’s public holiday calendar.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Everybody in the company sees noddo in it — screens, emails and exports.

dataset.title: Where do we start?
dataset.lead: Start with example data or with nothing. Every feature works either way.

sample.title: Example company
sample.body: Offices, departments, job titles, time off policies and example people. Enough to see how it works.

empty.title: Start empty
empty.body: Just your own account. Fields, roles and time off types are ready, nothing is filled in.

failed.starting: The last attempt stopped before it got going. Your answers are still here — try again.
failed.localization: The last attempt stopped: we couldn’t set your time zone and working week. Your answers are still here — try again.
failed.holidays: The last attempt stopped: we couldn’t build the public holiday calendar. Your answers are still here — try again.
failed.exampleData: The last attempt stopped: we couldn’t create your example company. Your answers are still here — try again.
failed.finishing: The last attempt stopped just before the end. Your answers are still here — try again.

building.title: Setting up your company
building.lead: This takes a few moments. You can leave this page — it will pick up where it left off.

steps.localization: Setting your time zone and working week

photo.title: Add your photo
photo.lead: Help your colleagues recognize you. You can change it any time.
photo.rules: Square, at least 400 × 400 px. PNG, JPG or WEBP.

qr.alt: A code to scan with your phone
qr.title: Scan the code with your phone
qr.body: You’ll pick a photo on your phone and it will appear here. The code works once, for the next 15 minutes.

arrived.title: Your photo is in
arrived.fromPhone: It came from your phone. You can change it any time.
arrived.fromFile: You can change it any time.

expired.title: The code has expired
expired.body: Codes work once, for 15 minutes. Press “Show a new code” and scan it again.

mobileAvatar.title: Add your photo
mobileAvatar.lead: Pick a photo for your profile at {company}.

uploading.title: Uploading…
uploading.body: Keep this page open for a moment.

done.title: That’s your photo
done.body: It’s already on your profile. You can close this page and go back to your computer.

failed.title: That didn’t work
failed.body: Show a new code on your computer and scan it again.

expired.title: This code has expired
expired.body: Codes work once, for 15 minutes. Show a new one on your computer and scan it again.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.hint: When something happened is shown in this zone. Dates in the calendar sense — a hire date, a day of leave — are the same day for everybody and do not move.

language.label: Language
language.hint: The language you see noddo in — screens and emails.

welcome.lead: A few quick settings, and you’re ready to go.

connect.title: Log in faster next time
connect.lead: Connect Google or Microsoft and skip the password from now on.
connect.leadOne: Connect {provider} and skip the password from now on.
connect.inUse: This {provider} account is already used by someone else at {company}. Try another one, or skip.
connect.failed: We couldn’t connect your {provider} account. Try again, or skip.

about.title: A bit about you
about.lead: A few details for your profile. All of it can wait.

preferences.title: How should things look?
preferences.lead: We’ve used {company}’s settings. Change them if they don’t fit you.
preferences.leadNoName: We’ve used your company’s settings. Change them if they don’t fit you.
